meta.source: New brand, 2026-11-11. Made from the mugham README, STATUS and issue 2, and the Koodam, Nookku and groundgate design systems. No code tokens exist yet.

tokens.name: bg
tokens.usage: The page ground under each thread, panel and card grid.

tokens.name: surface
tokens.usage: Cards, messages, the composer, forms, menus and the workbench panels.

tokens.name: surface-raised
tokens.usage: A raised tint: hover of a button or row, table headers, code blocks, the selected panel tab.

tokens.name: ink
tokens.usage: Body text and headings on bg, surface, surface-raised and each -bg fill. Lowest pair: light 14.74:1 on actor-person-bg; dark 11.64:1 on actor-agent-bg.

tokens.name: ink-muted
tokens.usage: Secondary text: the actor line, time, meta lines, field help, table headers. On bg, surface, surface-raised and the actor fills. Lowest pair: light 5.30:1 on actor-person-bg; dark 5.67:1 on actor-agent-bg.

tokens.name: border
tokens.usage: Decorative hairlines: card edges, dividers, table rows. 1.28:1 on surface (light), 1.30:1 (dark). Never the only edge of a control.

tokens.name: border-strong
tokens.usage: The edge of a control that takes text or a choice: a field, a select, a checkbox, the composer. Light 3.69:1 on surface, 3.28:1 on surface-raised; dark 3.91:1 and 3.53:1.

tokens.name: accent
tokens.usage: The one action hue: the primary button, links, a selected tab, a checked control. As text on bg, surface and surface-raised: light 5.42:1 or more, dark 7.40:1 or more. Same value as the Nookku and Koodam accent.

tokens.name: on-accent
tokens.usage: Text and icons on an accent fill. Light 6.09:1; dark 8.23:1.

tokens.name: focus
tokens.usage: The keyboard focus ring: a solid 2px outline with a 2px offset. 5.42:1 or more on each surface in light, 7.40:1 or more in dark.

tokens.name: ok
tokens.usage: The done state as text and icon: an action with its receipt, Approved, Passed. On ok-bg: light 4.72:1, dark 8.42:1. On surface too.

tokens.name: ok-bg
tokens.usage: The fill of a done pill or a done row.

tokens.name: warn
tokens.usage: A warning as text: a stale snapshot, a budget near its limit, a retry. On warn-bg: light 5.37:1, dark 9.50:1.

tokens.name: warn-bg
tokens.usage: The fill of a warning pill or banner.

tokens.name: error
tokens.usage: An error or a refusal as text: Rejected, Not sent, an undeclared component. On error-bg: light 6.53:1, dark 8.41:1. On bg, surface and surface-raised: 6.64:1 or more.

tokens.name: error-bg
tokens.usage: The fill of an error pill, an error row and the danger button.

tokens.name: pending
tokens.usage: An action that has no receipt yet: Sent, waiting; Queued offline. Always with the word and a dashed border. On pending-bg: light 5.72:1, dark 7.16:1.

tokens.name: pending-bg
tokens.usage: The fill of a pending pill and of a queued action card.

tokens.name: actor-person
tokens.usage: The name and the actor glyph of a person in the thread. On actor-person-bg: light 10.34:1, dark 9.03:1. On surface: 12.25:1 and 10.20:1.

tokens.name: actor-person-bg
tokens.usage: The fill of a message from a person.

tokens.name: actor-agent
tokens.usage: The name and the actor glyph of an agent in the thread. On actor-agent-bg: light 5.50:1, dark 8.34:1. On surface: 6.38:1 and 10.18:1. In dark it has the same lightness as actor-person: always show the actor name, never the hue alone.

tokens.name: actor-agent-bg
tokens.usage: The fill of a message from an agent.

tokens.name: brand-ink
tokens.usage: Mugham Ink. The mark and the wordmark on a light ground, and the ground of the icon, the hero and the social image. Sibling of the Koodam and Nookku inks. 15.23:1 on light bg.

tokens.name: brand-light
tokens.usage: Mugham Light. The mark and the wordmark on a dark ground or on brand-ink. 14.39:1 on brand-ink; 15.36:1 on dark surface.

tokens.name: brand-signal
tokens.usage: Mugham Peacock. The receipt dot of the mark, and one shape in a brand image. Never text. Light value on light grounds: 3.99:1 on surface. Dark value on dark grounds and on brand-ink: 7.92:1 on dark surface, 7.42:1 on brand-ink.

tokens.name: on-brand-ink
tokens.usage: Secondary text on a brand-ink ground: the hero tagline, a command on the hero. 10.19:1 on brand-ink, 8.20:1 on brand-ink-raised.

tokens.name: brand-ink-raised
tokens.usage: A panel on a brand-ink ground, for example a thread card in the hero. brand-light on it: 11.58:1.

tokens.name: brand-panel
tokens.usage: A large brand block on a page in both themes (the cover, an About band). In dark it is lighter than brand-ink, so the block stays visible on bg. Put brand-light on it.

tokens.name: logo-line
tokens.usage: The arches and the letters of an inline mark: brand-ink in light, brand-light in dark.

families.mono: "Geist Mono", ui-monospace, SFMono-Regular, Menlo, Consolas, monospace
families.tamil: "Noto Sans Tamil", "Tamil Sangam MN", Latha, sans-serif

styles.name: text-body
styles.usage: A message, a card body, form help. All running text.
styles.sample: The update changes 3 rules. Approve it, or send it back with a note.

styles.name: text-strong
styles.usage: A card title, the actor name, a field label.

styles.name: text-meta
styles.usage: Time, receipt ids, counts, field hints. Use tabular numbers.

styles.name: text-label
styles.usage: Panel labels and table headers, in uppercase.

styles.name: heading-1
styles.usage: The page title of a workbench panel or a docs page.

styles.name: heading-2
styles.usage: A section in a panel or a docs page.

styles.name: heading-3
styles.usage: A group of cards or a form section.

styles.name: display-brand
styles.usage: The word Mugham next to the mark in an app header.

styles.name: display-hero
styles.usage: The word mugham, in lower case, on the hero and the cover.

styles.name: display-tag
styles.usage: The one tagline line on the hero, on-brand-ink.
styles.sample: One thread for people and agents, on each device.

styles.name: code
styles.usage: A component name, a token, a receipt, a command.

styles.name: code-meta
styles.usage: A hash or an id in a meta line.

styles.name: tamil-name
styles.usage: The Tamil name, once, in an About section or the docs.

spacing.note: A 4px base. The kit uses these names as CSS variables.

tokens.name: space-1
tokens.usage: The gap in a pill, between an icon and its label.

tokens.name: space-2
tokens.usage: The gap of buttons in a row, of a field label and its field.

tokens.name: space-3
tokens.usage: Button side padding; the gap between messages of one actor.

tokens.name: space-4
tokens.usage: Card padding; the gap of a card grid; the page gutter on a phone.

tokens.name: space-5
tokens.usage: The gap between turns of different actors; panel padding.

tokens.name: space-6
tokens.usage: The gap between sections of a panel; the page gutter on a desktop.

tokens.name: space-7
tokens.usage: The space above an empty state; hero padding.

tokens.name: radius-sm
tokens.usage: Pills of text size, checkboxes, inline code, the focus ring.

tokens.name: radius-md
tokens.usage: Buttons, fields, menus, code blocks.

tokens.name: radius-lg
tokens.usage: Cards, messages, the composer, workbench panels, the icon tile.

tokens.name: radius-pill
tokens.usage: Status pills, the actor chip, the top of an arch.

tokens.name: shadow-raised
tokens.usage: The one shadow: a menu, a dialog, the composer. Cards in a grid use a border, not a shadow.
